about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: I'm a Full Stack Developer specialized in the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem (React, Node.js, Express, NestJS), with a formal university technical education in Systems. I live in Valencia, Spain, and work remotely for clients in digital banking, insurance, and insurtech.
about.paragraph2: Besides coding, I teach: for 3+ years I've been training developers in the MERN stack, mentoring 500+ students. Outside of code, I'm a passionate musician — something that shows in how I approach teamwork: listening, finding the project's rhythm, and delivering my part with precision.
